newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3- and 6-mo T-bill yields hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3- and 6-mo T-bill yields hold steady.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 57.30 percent, the same as at the last sale on August 23, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Wednesday.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Auction Number 127 126
Issue date August 27, 1996 August 23, 1996
Maturity date November 27, 1996 November 22, 1996
Denominations 10 million UAK 10 million UAK
Amount sold 735.94 billion UAK 4.571 trillion UAK
Actual amount raised 643.95 billion UAK 4.000 trillion UAK
Average yield 57.30 pct 57.30 pct
Average price 8.750 million UAK 8.750 million UAK
Cut-off price 8.750 million UAK 8.750 million UAK
Ukraine's central bank sold 73,594 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 44,234 were competitive and 29,360 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is not yet set.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 59.90 percent, the same as the last sale on August 20, a central bank statement said.
The results of Tuesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Auction Number 128 118
Issue date August 27, 1996 August 20, 1996
Maturity date February 26, 1997 February 19, 1997
Denominations 10 million UAK 10 million UAK
Amount sold 312.78 billion UAK 79.37 billion UAK
Actual amount raised 240.84 billion UAK 61.11 billion UAK
Average yield 59.90 pct 59.90 pct
Average price 7.700 million UAK 7.700 million UAK
Cut-off price 7.700 million UAK 7.700 million UAK
Of the 31,278 T-bills sold by the central bank, 26,000 were competitive and 5,278 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is not yet fixed.
Vitaly Myhashko, head of the central bank's capital markets and exchange department, said auctions of nine- and twelve-month treasury bills scheduled for August 27 did not take place.
Instead, the next auction of nine- and twelve-month bills will be on August 29, he said.
